title: S01 Open Railway Flatbed Wagon
description: Original static low railway flatbed wagon with three broad longitudinal freight deck boards, visible supporting underframe, two fixed transverse axles, four independent tread and inner-flange groups, restrained low end rails and fixed coupling blocks. Same rail interface as the existing inspection trolley: tread centers X plus/minus .54 m, local flange bottom Z=0 and tread bottom Z=.04 m; place at Z=.16 m on the original rail head top Z=.20 m. Deck top then reaches .77 m. Actual fixed-pose support, platform side clearance and stopped buffer gap are checked from imported GLBs. Editable fixed source and GLB components only; no wheel animation, dynamic coupling, running, load or railway safety specification.
